subject: Atlas: design review moved
body:
Hi Riya,

The Atlas design review is now on 20 November at 15:00 in Room Banyan. Pooja will present the new home screen. Can you bring the usage numbers for overdue tasks?

Thanks,
Meera

subject: Home screen mockups v3
body:
Hi Riya,

v3 of the home screen mockups is in the Atlas folder. Main change: overdue tasks are now grouped by due date. Let me know what you think before Thursday.

Pooja

subject: Your leave balance
body:
Hi Riya,

This is a reminder that you have 11 days of annual leave left for 2026. Up to 10 days can be carried forward; anything above that lapses on 31 December.

People Team

subject: Customer asking about Business plan SSO
body:
Hi Riya,

A prospect (BrightPath Logistics, 80 users) wants to know if SSO works with Azure AD. Do we have a product answer I can share?

Kabir

subject: Scheduled VPN maintenance
body:
Hello,

The Acme VPN will be unavailable on Saturday 14 November from 22:00 to 23:30 for maintenance. Please plan any remote work around this window.

IT

subject: Top 5 support tickets last week
body:
Hi Riya,

Top issues last week: 1) Calendar sync delays, 2) Can't find archived boards, 3) Notification overload on mobile, 4) Export to CSV missing columns, 5) SSO setup questions. Notification overload is up 40% since October.

Ananya

subject: Sprint 22 scope
body:
Riya,

For Sprint 22 we can fit the overdue-task grouping and the dark mode toggle. Offline mode stays in the next release. Please confirm by Friday.

Meera

subject: Expense claim approved
body:
Hi Riya,

Your expense claim EXP-2291 (INR 3,450, customer visit taxis) has been approved and will be paid with the November salary.

Finance

subject: All-hands on Friday
body:
Team,

Our Q4 all-hands is on Friday 13 November at 17:00 in the cafeteria. We will share Q3 results and the 2027 roadmap. Snacks provided.

Rohan

subject: Usability test participants
body:
Hi Riya,

I need 5 customers for the Atlas usability test on 25 November. Could you ask Ananya for names of active Team-plan users?

Pooja

subject: API for team updates
body:
Hi Riya,

The team-updates feed needs a new API endpoint. I estimate 4 days of work. Should I start this sprint or next?

Sameer

subject: Learning budget reminder
body:
Hi Riya,

You have INR 18,000 of your 2026 learning budget left. Unused budget does not carry forward, so submit requests before 31 December.

People Team

subject: Re: Customer asking about Business plan SSO
body:
Thanks Riya, I'll tell them SSO supports SAML and works with Azure AD. They also asked about the audit log export format. Is it CSV?

Kabir

subject: Can you review the Atlas PRD?
body:
Hi Riya,

Can you review section 3 of the Atlas PRD (team updates) by Tuesday? I left comments on the open questions.

Meera

subject: Phishing awareness
body:
Hello,

We are seeing emails pretending to be from IT asking staff to 'verify' their passwords. IT will never ask for your password. Report suspicious emails to security@acme.local.

Security

subject: Customer quote for Atlas launch post
body:
Hi Riya,

BrightPath's ops head is happy to give a quote for the Atlas launch blog post. Want me to set up a call?

Ananya

subject: Q4 budget for usability tests
body:
Hi Riya,

The Q4 budget for usability tests is INR 25,000. Gift vouchers for participants should be INR 1,500 each.

Neha

subject: Icons for dark mode
body:
Hi Riya,

The dark mode icon set is ready. Three icons still look too dim; I'll fix them by Wednesday.

Pooja

subject: Quick question
body:
Riya, do we need analytics events for the new home screen in the first release, or can they wait?

Meera

subject: Atlas board update
body:
Riya,

Please send me a 5-line Atlas status update by Thursday evening for the board meeting.

Rohan
